start: Staff & sign-in; a desk person who lost the phone

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out everywhere' on the person's row and confirm
user_sees: The person's devices count goes to 0
Their row shows '· No PIN yet'
must_not: The owner's own device signed out
The person's old PIN still working

steps.action: The person tries the old PIN on any device
must_not: The gym opens

start: Staff & sign-in; the owner's own row, signed in on a laptop and a phone

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out other devices', answer 'Sign out your other devices?'
must_not: This device signed out
The owner left with no PIN and no word about it

start: A desk person, or a person already removed

steps.action: A desk key asks to sign a person out
must_not: The desk signing out the owner

steps.action: Owner signs out a person removed a moment ago on another device
must_not: An error with code words

start: A desk person was signed out everywhere

steps.action: The person signs in with a new code from the owner
must_not: The old PIN asked for

steps.action: Owner signs them out everywhere again
user_sees: Devices 0 and '· No PIN yet' again
must_not: The second sign-out doing nothing

user_sees: Name, phone, role, devices count, last seen, PIN state
must_not: People of another gym
Device names or places of another person shown to the desk

start: HQ app, a gym whose owner cannot sign in; HQ has called the gym's own number

steps.action: Open the gym, tick 'I called the gym's own number and the owner confirmed', reset the owner sign-in
user_sees: Owner's name, phone and a new 6-digit code with its end time
must_not: A code made without the tick
The owner's old PIN still working

steps.action: Read the code to the owner; owner signs in and sets a new PIN
user_sees: Owner's gym opens, then '· PIN set'
must_not: The code working for another gym

start: HQ app, a gym with two owners

must_not: The code made for a random owner
The other owner's PIN cleared
A code made

steps.action: Reset the same gym a 6th time in one hour
must_not: A 6th code made

steps.action: A gym-panel key calls the HQ reset
must_not: Any code returned

steps.action: Owner signs in with the code and sets a PIN
must_not: Code usable again after use

user_sees: New code; the new PIN cleared too
must_not: The PIN set after the first reset still working

steps.action: Look at the HQ log line of the reset
user_sees: Who did it, when, 'called the gym and the owner confirmed', the last 4 digits of the owner phone
must_not: The full phone or the code kept in the log
